stories.title: Maharashtra: Golden Jackal Killed In Accident On Airoli-Mulund Link Road, Raising Wildlife Safety Concerns
stories.summary: The incident, which was reported on Friday, November 27, has once again raised concerns over the safety of the creatures, which are protected under the Wildlife Protection Act. Following the death of the species, naturalist and wildlife photographer Mahesh Yadav said the repeated deaths point to an urgent need for intervention.

stories.title: Bandra Terminus platform 5 to shut for 75 days from December 1, several trains diverted
stories.summary: Several train services will be disrupted for 75 days from December 1 as Western Railway shuts platform 5 at Mumbai’s Bandra Terminus for major repairs, with long-distance trains diverted or short-terminated and suburban services facing delays. The work will involve uprooting the tracks, removing the existing cement concrete apron and relaying the foundation in phases, railway sources said.

stories.title: BMC approves 15-year Raymond deal for helipad at Coastal Road South jetty
stories.summary: The BMC Standing Committee on Thursday approved a proposal seeking appointment of Raymond Ltd as the developer and operator of a helipad planned to come up at an existing jetty site at the Coastal Road South. Congress on Friday opposed the appointment, demanding that water metro should be built at the jetty instead, claiming that this would be a more beneficial mode of public transport.

stories.title: 88-year-old Mumbai man forced to live in old-age home since 2022 after gifting flat to son; Bombay HC cancels deed, restores house, says right to residence includes maintenance
stories.summary: Observing that an 88-year-old man with no financial resources or alternative accommodation had been forced to reside in an old-age home in Mumbai since 2022 after executing a gift deed in favour of his son in 2018, the Bombay high court set aside the gift deed and restored his house to him.

stories.title: WR to undertake 75-day block at Bandra Terminus; check affected trains
stories.summary: Western Railway will undertake a 75-day traffic block at Mumbai's Bandra Terminus from December 1, 2026, to February 13, 2027, to repair and reconstruct the cement concrete (CC) apron at Platform 5. The work will affect several Mail and Express trains, with services being shifted to Dadar, short-terminated or short-originated at Borivali, and four suburban trains cancelled during the period.

stories.title: Diljit Dosanjh Mumbai concert: Two people test positive for drugs at singer's event
stories.summary: Mumbai Police used its newly launched anti-drug forensic vehicle at Diljit Dosanjh's concert at Mahalaxmi Racecourse, where nearly 40 young attendees were checked for suspected drug use. Two of them reportedly tested positive. Two tested positive at the Diljit Dosanjh concertAccording to the India Today report, about 40 youths were screened at Diljit Dosanjh's concert.

stories.title: Bandra railway station celebrates 162 years with three-day festival
stories.summary: Mumbai’s iconic Bandra railway station is celebrating its 162nd anniversary with a three-day heritage and cultural festival, bringing together history, art, music and public participation at one of the city's finest railway landmarks. Organised by Western Railway’s Mumbai Division, the Bandra Station Mahotsav 2026 is being held from November 27 to 29 to commemorate the station’s opening on November 28, 1864.

stories.title: Diljit Dosanjh Invites Sanya Malhotra On Stage, Dances With Her At Mumbai Concert
stories.summary: Diljit Dosanjh's Mumbai concert turned into a star-studded affair, with several celebrities joining fans for an evening of music and entertainment. While the likes of Karisma Kapoor, Disha Patani and Avneet Kaur were among those spotted at the event, Sanya Malhotra stole the show when Diljit invited her on stage for an impromptu dance.

stories.title: DRI Busts Two Wildlife Trafficking Networks In Maharashtra, Seizes Suspected King Cobra Venom And Big Cat Skins, Six Held
stories.summary: Mumbai: In back-to-back intelligence-led enforcement operations focused on curbing illegal wildlife trade and protecting endangered species, officers of the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) dismantled two separate illicit wildlife trafficking networks active around Western Ghat Region in Maharashtra, apprehending six individuals and seizing suspected King Cobra venom alongside big cat skins and a poaching weapon.

stories.title: Mumbai: Man accused of selling beef illegally found dead inside Arthur Road Jail
stories.summary: A 58-year-old man arrested earlier this week for allegedly selling beef illegally was found dead inside Arthur Road Jail in Mumbai, a police official said on Saturday. According to PTI, Asgarali Mohammad Yamin Qureshi was arrested following a raid in the Shivaji Nagar area in the eastern suburb of Govandi on November 24.

stories.title: Residents protest Metro 11 office on Bandra plot reserved for garden
stories.summary: Construction work is underway on a 3,500-sq m plot in Bandra (East). Six pits, each 4 feet deep, have been dug for the foundation of a site office for Metro Line 11. The site office will accommodate the cabins of 15 department heads of the Mumbai Metro Rail Corporation Ltd (MMRCL).

stories.title: Mumbai architects urge wetland park at Mahalaxmi Racecourse
stories.summary: The Mumbai Architects Collective (MAC), comprising architects, urbanists and transport experts, has written to Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis and Municipal Commissioner Ashwini Bhide, welcoming the decision to drop the proposed underground sports complex, convention facility and multilevel car park at Mahalaxmi Racecourse. The collective has sought a formal written order confirming the decision and urged the state government to introduce a permanent policy protecting the city’s public open spaces.

stories.title: Mumbai: Fire breaks out in Kandivali East residential building
stories.summary: A Level-I fire broke out on the fourth floor of a residential building in Kandivali East, Mumbai, on Friday, November 27. The fire was extinguished by the Mumbai Fire Brigade, and no injuries were reported in the incident. As per the officials, the fire was reported at around 8:50 pm on November 27 at Saraswati Building, located in Thakur Village near D-Mart, Kandivali East.

stories.title: Mumbai Customs team seizes drugs, gold worth ₹39.8 crore at airport; nine arrested
stories.summary: 8 crore in multiple operations, leading to the arrest of nine passengers and suspected cartel members,” sources said. In one of the biggest seizures, officers of the Air Intelligence Unit (AIU), Customs Zone-III, recovered around 12 kg of ketamine, valued at approximately ₹36 crore, in an operation conducted on November 27.

stories.title: 60-year-old woman sexually assaulted in Mumbai's Ghatkopar station washroom
stories.summary: A woman passenger was allegedly sexually assaulted by an unidentified man inside an unmanned ladies’ washroom at Ghatkopar railway station on Thursday night. The Kurla Government Railway Police (GRP) arrested the accused on Friday evening after examining CCTV footage to identify the suspect, who was seen leaving the washroom in a hurry and heading towards the Metro station.

stories.title: Two arrested with charas worth ₹12.20 crore at Lokmanya Tilak Terminus in Mumbai
stories.summary: 20 crore from their possession at Lokmanya Tilak Terminus (LTT) during an operation conducted on the intervening night of November 24 and 25. A case was registered on November 25 under Sections 8(c), 20(c) and 29 of the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act, 1985.

stories.title: Mumbai Local Train Update: Mega Block On Central, Trans-Harbour Lines Tomorrow; Western Railway To Carry Out
stories.summary: Mumbai: Mumbai commuters are likely to face changes in local train services on Sunday, November 29, as Central Railway and the Trans-Harbour line will operate under scheduled mega blocks for track maintenance and technical work on signalling systems. Western Railway will also undertake maintenance work during the intervening night of Saturday and Sunday, but there will be no daytime block on its suburban network.

stories.summary: Stay informed without the overload. Every evening, we bring you the day's biggest developments in one fast, balanced digest. No fluff, no sensationalism. stories.title: 17-yr-old dies after dogs chase him in Badlapur
stories.summary: A 17-year-old Class 12 student died after a pack of stray dogs allegedly chased him in Badlapur West on Thursday. The teenager, who had undergone bypass surgery three years ago, ran to escape the dogs and soon developed chest discomfort and breathing difficulties. He was rushed to Badlapur Rural Hospital, where he was declared dead.

stories.title: Congress opposes proposal to hand over Worli jetty to private firm for helipad, seeks Water Metro terminal
stories.summary: The Congress has opposed the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation’s (BMC) proposal to hand over the Worli jetty to a private company for constructing a helipad, arguing that the site should instead be developed as a Water Metro terminal to promote public transport. The proposal was passed at the standing committee meeting on Thursday.

stories.title: Mumbai to see clear skies on Saturday, AQI in 'moderate' category
stories.summary: Mumbai is likely to experience mainly clear skies on Saturday, November 28, with warm and dry weather conditions expected across the city and its adjoining suburbs, according to the India Meteorological Department (IMD). With no rainfall forecast, the temperatures across the city are expected to remain relatively comfortable during the early morning before rising through the day.

stories.title: Mumbai: Man arrested in illegal meat sale case found dead inside Arthur Road Jail
stories.summary: A 58-year-old man arrested earlier this week for allegedly selling beef illegally was found dead inside Arthur Road Jail in Mumbai, a police official said on Saturday. According to PTI, Asgarali Mohammad Yamin Qureshi was arrested following a raid in the Shivaji Nagar area in the eastern suburb of Govandi on November 24.

stories.title: After an 85% surge in 6 months, HSBC sees another 28% upside in jewellery stock Kalyan Jewellers; up 878% in 5 years
stories.summary: Kalyan Jewellers share price target : Kalyan Jewellers has delivered an extraordinary rally, gaining nearly 86% in six months and a staggering 878% over five years. Yet, HSBC believes the jewellery retailer has further room to rise, retaining its bullish stance on the stock.

stories.title: Thane needs 1,350 buses but TMT operates only 381, NCP (SP) claims
stories.summary: Nationalist Congress Party (Sharadchandra Pawar) on Saturday said that the Thane Municipal Transport (TMT) is facing an acute shortage of over 950 buses. They also allege that the civic bus service is being deliberately weakened to benefit the upcoming Ring Metro project.

stories.title: Thane Faces Shortage Of Nearly 950 TMT Buses, NCP (SP) Questions Whether Ring Metro Project Is Being Favoured
stories.summary: Public transport in Thane is facing a severe crunch due to a sharp shortage of buses operated by the Thane Municipal Transport (TMT), leaving daily commuters in distress. While a city with a population of roughly 27 lakh requires about 1,350 buses for public transit, only 381 TMT buses are currently running on the roads—a shortfall of nearly 950 buses.

stories.title: Commuter attacked with sharp weapon after confronting beedi smokers
stories.summary: A passenger was allegedly slashed in the face with a sharp weapon after he objected to two men smoking beedis inside the luggage compartment of a moving Kasara-CSMT slow local on Friday morning. The attack, which took place between Kalyan and Thakurli, left the commuter injured near his eye.

stories.title: Virar Sports Complex Named After Former MLA Hitendra Thakur Amid BVA-BJP Political Row, Proposal Passed With 68 Votes
stories.summary: A fresh political row had erupted in the city over naming the Vasai-Virar City Municipal Corporation’s (VVCMC) much-discussed sports complex in Bolinj, Virar West a project that had been stalled for nearly eight years. While various sports organizations demanded naming the complex after former MLA Hitendra Thakur, BJP Leader of the Opposition Manoj Patil submitted a memorandum to the Mayor demanding it be named after ‘Narveer Chimaji Appa.’

stories.title: 4 armed robbers smash car windows, escape with 16.4kg gold worth Rs 20 crore in daring Navi Mumbai heist
stories.summary: 4 kg of gold bars being transported by employees from Zaveri Bazar. The robbers violently smashed the windows and stole the gold, prompting a swift police investigation. Law enforcement is currently analyzing CCTV footage and working to locate the owner of the rented vehicle involved in this audacious heist.

stories.title: Delimitation Bill LIVE: 'The number 850 represents murder of democracy,' says Rahul; DMK announces support for Centre's proposal
stories.summary: T he Union Cabinet has approved the Constitution Amendment Bill providing a proportionate increase of 50% seats across all States. This ratio will continue for 25 years till it changes according to the population in the Census after 2051. The government has called for a special sitting of Parliament beginning Monday (November 30, 2026) to move the Bills to implement the delimitation exercise across the nation.

stories.title: 'Joota khayega?': Man dumping waste into Yamuna threatens content creator who confronts him
stories.summary: The man, when questioned about why he was throwing material into the river, reportedly replied “Astrology” before getting into a heated argument and threatening the creator with, “Gaali khayega... ”“Sir, what is the reason for putting this? There must be some reason, faith, power, what is it?” The exchange soon turns confrontational, with the man allegedly abusing and threatening to hit Kamal with a shoe.

stories.title: Karnataka to launch ‘Delhi Chalo’ protest if Centre fails to release drought relief: D.K. Shivakumar
stories.summary: K. Shivakumar on Saturday (November 28) said Karnataka would organise a ‘Delhi Chalo’ protest after the Assembly session in December if the Centre failed to release drought relief funds before the session concluded. He said the State had not received any financial assistance from the Union government for drought relief and that no announcement had been made on the matter.

stories.title: Deepam lit atop Thiruparankundram Hill amid tight security after SC order
stories.summary: The lighting followed a fresh direction issued by the Supreme Court on Friday. The court appointed retired Madras high court judges Justice S Vaidyanathan and Justice V Parthiban as receivers of the Arulmigu Subramaniya Swamy Temple and entrusted them with ensuring compliance with its direction.

stories.title: Salman Khan's Maatrubhumi Gets U/A 16+ Certificate Without Any Cuts Or Disclaimers: Report
stories.summary: Salman Khan-starrer Maatrubhumi was slated for release in April this year, but the movie was postponed. There were reports that the makers reshot the film as there were objections from the Ministry of Defence. At the trailer launch, Salman clarified that there were no such issues, and the delay was because of the VFX work.

stories.title: Aditya Dhar says he is a 'Yami PAGLU' in birthday post for Yami Gautam: 'You are my home'
stories.summary: Yami Gautam turned 38 on Saturday, and her husband, filmmaker Aditya Dhar, marked the day with a loving social media post. Sharing unseen vacation pictures, the 'Dhurandhar' director described what she means to him and how much she has shaped his life. Aditya Dhar's loving birthday post for Yami GautamAditya Dhar posted a set of previously unseen photos from the couple's holiday on Instagram.

stories.title: 'Friendship started very organically': Yami Gautam reveals how her love story with Aditya Dhar began; rec
stories.summary: Actress Yami Gautam has revisited the early days of her relationship with filmmaker Aditya Dhar, revealing how their professional association gradually turned into a romance. The two first met while working on the 2019 film 'Uri: The Surgical Strike'. However, neither approached the other with romantic intentions during the initial stages.

stories.title: Sanjay Raut questions NCP (SP)'s support for BJP-backed delimitation bill
stories.summary: Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Sanjay Raut on Saturday criticised the Nationalist Congress Party (Sharadchandra Pawar) for its reported decision to support the proposed delimitation bill, calling it a unilateral move that people of Maharashtra would reject. Speaking to PTI, the Rajya Sabha MP alleged that the proposed legislation was intended to undermine democracy and the country's federal structure.

stories.title: "Our 3 MPs Will Vote In Favour": BRS Announces Support For Delimitation Bill
stories.summary: T. Rama Rao on Saturday said the party’s three Rajya Sabha members would vote in favour of the delimitation proposal, keeping Telangana’s interests paramount. In a social media post (on X), Mr. Rama Rao said the BRS had consistently demanded that South India’s existing 24% share in Parliament be protected and maintained, and that it would not tolerate any injustice to Telangana in the delimitation exercise.

stories.title: Mayawati supports women’s reservation Bill, seeks separate quota for SC, ST women
stories.summary: Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) president Mayawati on Saturday (November 28, 2026) supported the Union Government’s move to provide 33% reservation for women in Parliament and in the State Assemblies, but said “it would have been better” to have a separate quota within it for women from the Scheduled Castes (SCs) and Scheduled Tribes (STs).

stories.title: Sooraj Barjatya recalls losing his cool, throwing mic at Abhishek Bachchan and Kareena Kapoor during Main Prem Ki Diwani Hoon shoot
stories.summary: Bollywood filmmaker Sooraj Barjatya made his directorial comeback after four years with Yeh Prem Mol Liya. Actors who have worked with him have often spoken about his soft-spoken and supportive nature. However, in a recent podcast with Siddharth Kannan, the filmmaker revealed that he once lost his cool on the sets of Main Prem Ki Diwani Hoon .

stories.title: "Found 17 Bodies": Many Killed After Airstrike Hits Myanmar Wedding Venue
stories.summary: Myanmar has been in the throes of civil war since a coup deposed Aung San Suu Kyi's elected government in 2021, and monitoring group ACLED says more than 100,000 people have been killed on all sides.

stories.summary: The sample was collected from the company's manufacturing unit in Telipara village in Jalpaiguri district. Both the primary laboratory and the referral food laboratory reportedly confirmed the presence of coliform bacteria, raising concerns over the quality and safety of the packaged drinking water. According to reports, the affected batch, bearing the identification number PB 201, was manufactured around July 20, 2026.

stories.title: Pond heron found dead in Coimbatore tests positive for avian influenza
stories.summary: More than a week after several pond herons were found dead in a single locality in Coimbatore, one bird sample that was sent to the ICAR-National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD) in Bhopal tested positive for avian influenza (H5N1). Officials said the result from NIHSAD was received on Friday (November 27, 2026).

stories.title: Bihar Minister resigns from the post of Assistant Professor to avoid ‘unnecessary controversy’
stories.summary: Ahead of the special parliament session called from November 30, 2026 when the centre is likely to table an amended Delimitation Bill, Bihar Minister Ashok Choudhary who was mired in controversy for last few days over office-of-profit row, on Saturday (November 28, 2026), said he has resigned from the post of Assistant Professor.

stories.title: Madurai Deepam Row: Lamp To Be Lit At Disputed Deepathoon Today, Hindus Welcome CRPF With Flowers
stories.summary: flowers | ANI The disputed Karthigai Deepam ritual at Thiruparankundram Hill in Madurai, is scheduled to take place today following a Supreme Court directive ordering the ceremonial lamp to be lit at the Deepathoon (stone pillar). Amid heightened security, CRPF personnel have taken charge of the hill, with local Hindu devotees welcoming them by showering flower petals on their vehicles.

stories.title: 'How Can One Compromise On Ideology?': NCP (SP) Leader Rameshwar Khamkar Resigns Over Party's Support For Delimitation Bill
stories.summary: According to news agency IANS , Rameshwar Khamkar, the party's state general secretary of the Social Media Cell, submitted his resignation on Friday, November 27. In his resignation letter, he said he was stepping down in protest against the party's decision to support the BJP on the issue of the Delimitation Bill.

stories.summary: Senior leaders of the INDIA bloc, including Congress's Mallikarjun Kharge and Rahul Gandhi, SP chief Akhilesh Yadav, and Mamata Banerjee, will attend a 'Constitution Protection March' in Bhopal on December 12. 5 lakh people, according to the Madhya Pradesh Congress Committee (MPCC), which has sought the Lal Parade Ground in Bhopal as the venue for the rally, MP Congress media coordinator Abhinav Barolia told PTI.

stories.title: Malaysian travel agent among accused after 164 foreigners rescued in Noida
stories.summary: They were allegedly lured to India with promises of lucrative IT jobs, but forced into cyber crime, according to police. Police say the scheme was exposed after a Malaysian worker managed to escape and revealed the operation.

stories.title: Chhatarpur Youth Dies After Tractor Hits Bike; Woman Allegedly Dies By Suicide Hours Later
stories.summary: Chhatarpur (Madhya Pradesh): Two separate deaths have been reported in Madhya Pradesh's Chhatarpur district. A 22-year-old man died during treatment after a sand-laden tractor hit his motorcycle on the Naogaon-Dadri Bilhari road. Hours later, a 23-year-old woman allegedly died by suicide at her home in Niwari village under Garhi Malhara police station limits.

stories.title: Gujarat ATS searches Assam man’s house over alleged JeM links, Vadodara plot
stories.summary: A three-member team of the Gujarat Anti-Terrorism Squad (ATS), accompanied by Assam police, searched the house of a 22-year-old man in Assam’s Sribhumi district for more than eight hours on Friday over his alleged links with Pakistan-based terror outfit Jaish-e-Mohammed (JeM), officials confirmed on Saturday.

stories.title: Delimitation Bill a bid to reduce political representation of south Indian States: Chennithala
stories.summary: The Delimitation Bill will reduce the political representation of the south Indian States and destroy the federal system in the country, Home Minister Ramesh Chennithala has said. His statement comes against the backdrop of the Union government convening a special sitting of Parliament where it is likely to table an amended delimitation Bill.

stories.summary: In a discovery straight out of the crime drama Breaking Bad , Spanish authorities have busted an elaborate underground marijuana cultivation facility concealed beneath what appeared to be an ordinary children's playground. The secret farm, located in Las Gabias near Granada in southern Spain, contained nearly 2,000 cannabis plants and was equipped with advanced systems to support large-scale cultivation.

stories.title: Two Italians killed in strike in Kuwait, as Iran denies responsibility
stories.summary: Two Italian nationals have died after an Iranian strike on a facility in Kuwait, Italy's foreign ministry has said. The pair were technicians working for German arms manufacturing company Rheinmetall, the ministry added. Kuwait's defence ministry earlier said that four people - the two Italians, a Kuwaiti national and Pakistani national - had been injured from falling shrapnel after a number of drones from Iran were detected and intercepted.

stories.title: Two staff killed in Israeli strike on Gaza medical clinic, MSF says
stories.summary: Two workers for the medical charity Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) have been killed in an Israeli strike in Gaza, according to the organisation. MSF said the strike was a direct hit on one of the charity's clinics, the location of which was known by the Israeli military. In a statement, the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) said the two people were Hamas operatives "acting as security guards at a clinic operated by MSF".

stories.title: Ukraine's attack on Russian ship in Libya was not coordinated with partners, says Zelenskyy
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirmed during a call with Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni that Ukraine's operation to sink a Russian warship at a Libyan naval base lacked prior coordination with European allies. Following Meloni's warning against Mediterranean escalation, Zelenskyy pledged regular communication and information sharing with European partners.

stories.title: Australian wrestler Bronson Reed dies aged 38, WWE says
stories.summary: Professional wrestler Bronson Reed has died aged 38, World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE) has announced. The company said the wrestler, whose real name is Jermaine Haley, died on Friday due to medical complications but did not give further details. Paying tribute, WWE added: "Jermaine was a larger-than-life figure in WWE, but more importantly, he was a phenomenal person, a devoted family man, and a beloved colleague."

stories.title: Several students killed in blast beside Afghan school
stories.summary: At least six students have been killed and 97 injured in an explosion beside a middle school in Asadabad, eastern Afghanistan, after dynamite used for mining was stored in a neighbouring house.

stories.title: Taiwan Votes in Close Local Elections With China Watching
stories.summary: Puma Shen , a 44-year-old DPP lawmaker, told supporters in central Taipei that he had called Chiang to concede, urging supporters to respect the result and not question the vote count. Many in the crowd were in tears, but others shouted encouragement from the sidelines. “You didn’t lose,” said one.

stories.title: Eight killed in Peruvian military helicopter crash
stories.summary: Eight military personnel have been killed in a helicopter crash in a remote area of Peru known for growing and trafficking drugs. Authorities say the aircraft came down near the town of Sanabamba during a mission to evacuate an army patrol in the valley of the Apurimac, Ene, and Mantaro rivers, known by its Spanish acronym VRAEM.

stories.title: Several students feared dead, injured in explosion at middle school in Afghanistan | World News
stories.summary: Several students are feared wounded or killed after an explosion at a middle school in the eastern Afghan province of Kunar, reports said on Saturday. Farid Dehqan, spokesperson for the Kunar Provincial Police Headquarters, said the explosion occurred at 10 am at a school in the province's Andar Ser area, adding that several students were killed or wounded in the blast.

stories.title: Woman, 21, dies in crash following police pursuit
stories.summary: A 21-year-old woman has died in a crash following a police pursuit in Staffordshire. The front-seat passenger of a Seat Ibiza, which had been followed by officers, died at the scene of the crash in Rugeley Road, Hednesford, just after 23:00 GMT on Friday, Staffordshire Police said. The force said the Seat collided with an Vauxhall Astra, which was also being driven by members of the public, after the "short police pursuit".

stories.title: Kenyan doomsday cult leader convicted over further 123 deaths
stories.summary: A court in Kenya has convicted the leader of a doomsday Christian cult of the manslaughter of 123 of his followers. Paul Mackenzie was found guilty in Mombasa of ordering his followers, all adults, to fast to death in Shakahola forest near the coast between January 2021 and September 2023.

stories.title: Runway Scare! Two American Airlines Planes Clip Wings While Taxiing At Washingtons Reagan National Airport |
stories.summary: Watch | X Washington DC: Two American Airlines aircraft clipped each other's wings while taxiing for departure at Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport on Friday evening (local time), with no injuries reported.

stories.title: Afghanistan explosion kills 10 students and injures more than 100, official says
stories.summary: At least 10 students have been killed and 110 others have been injured following an explosion near a school in Afghanistan, a spokesperson has told the BBC. The incident happened on Saturday morning in the Anderseir area of Asadabad, the capital of Kunar province, the spokesperson for the Taliban government's interior ministry said.

stories.title: Conservatives set to win government in Australia's second-most populous state Victoria
stories.summary: Conservatives were set to win Saturday's election in the Australian state of Victoria, denying a breakthrough by the One Nation anti-immigration party and throwing out an unpopular Labor government after more than a decade. "Victorians have spoken, and their message is clear: they want change," said Premier Ben Carroll, conceding defeat.

stories.title: Argentina's bid to stop Falklands oil drilling rejected
